title: 687. Kth Smallest Number in Multiplication Table

examples.explanation: The 3 by 3 table holds [1,2,3,2,4,6,3,6,9]; ordered they are [1,2,2,3,3,4,6,6,9], so the 5th value is 3.
The 2 by 3 table holds [1,2,3,2,4,6]; the 6th smallest is 6.

hints: Count how many table entries are at most mid by adding min(n, mid / row) over each row.
The count grows monotonically with mid, so binary-search the smallest mid whose count reaches k.
Rows and columns are symmetric; iterate over the smaller dimension when counting.
